1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents are specifically formatted proofs of claim documents;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include creditor-specific information not previously aggregated;
and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations via direct electronic submission to each organization's filing system.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the method further comprises translating the bankruptcy documents into formats compatible with each court's specific electronic filing requirements.

6. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim and wherein the proof of claim includes supporting documentation specific to each creditor's claim;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and are formatted according to each organization's specific filing rules and requirements;
and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations via direct electronic transmission to each bankruptcy court's filing system.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the proofs of claims are automatically reformatted for each court's specific electronic filing format requirements.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors of the filing status and confirmation of proofs of claims filed on their behalf with specific bankruptcy case information.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol with encryption and authentication verification.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site portal that validates and stores creditor data records.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day with each bankruptcy court's electronic filing system.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report specific to each creditor's filed proofs of claims;
and
sending the report to a particular creditor with filing confirmation details.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site portal that retrieves filing status information.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed, including validation errors or court system rejections.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim from each bankruptcy court's electronic filing system.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer that interfaces directly with each bankruptcy court's electronic filing system.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record against each bankruptcy court's specific filing requirements and proof of claim format specifications.
